Getting Started¶

This section describes how to install TIARS Designer and its dependencies

Dependencies¶

Use conda to create an environment and install the dependencies listed in the ‘requirements.txt’ file in the top level of the repository.

conda create -p ./env --file requirements.txt

Installing TIARS Designer¶

With the conda environmnent activated, install TIARS designer using pip

conda activate ./env
pip install -i https://test.pypi.org/simple/ tiarsdesigner

To test whether installation was successful, run the tool without any inputs:

tiarsdesigner

If the tool was successfully installed you should see the following usage message:

usage: tiarsdesigner [-h] [–single-enzyme-filters SINGLE_ENZYME_FILTERS [SINGLE_ENZYME_FILTERS …]] [–enzyme-pair-filters ENZYME_PAIR_FILTERS [ENZYME_PAIR_FILTERS …]]

[–codon-usage-tsv CODON_USAGE_TSV] [–min-Rsite-distance MIN_RSITE_DISTANCE] [–enzymes ENZYMES] [–verbose] endogenous_seq gRNA_start gRNA_end PAM_start which_PAM AA_change_site new_codon locus_name
